hypotheses.name: PMC NO 0.75-0.80 near 5h high
hypotheses.description: Late premium NO continuation performs best when the NO contract is in the 0.75-0.80 range, spread is manageable, downside momentum still confirms, and the target sits near the rolling 5-hour BTC high.
hypotheses.sql:
WITH signal_ctx AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS signal_id,
    s.contract_price,
    s.spread,
    s.time_remaining_seconds,
    s.momentum_score,
    s.target_price,
    (
      SELECT MAX(bt.btc_price)
      FROM btc_ticks bt
      WHERE bt.recorded_at <= s.recorded_at
        AND bt.recorded_at > s.recorded_at - INTERVAL 5 HOUR
    ) AS rolling_5h_high
  FROM signals s
  WHERE s.rule_name = 'premium_momentum_continuation'
    AND s.rule_version = 'v1'
    AND s.side = 'NO'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN target_price >= rolling_5h_high - 100 THEN 'within_100'
    WHEN target_price >= rolling_5h_high - 200 THEN 'within_200'
    WHEN target_price >= rolling_5h_high - 300 THEN 'within_300'
    ELSE 'more_than_300_below'
  END AS target_vs_5h_high,
  COUNT(*) AS trades,
  ROUND(AVG(pt.pnl > 0) * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(pt.pnl), 4) AS total_pnl,
  ROUND(AVG(pt.pnl), 4) AS avg_pnl,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pt.pnl > 0 THEN pt.pnl END), 4) AS avg_win,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pt.pnl < 0 THEN pt.pnl END), 4) AS avg_loss,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN pt.pnl > 0 THEN pt.pnl ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.pnl < 0 THEN pt.pnl ELSE 0 END)), 0),
    2
  ) AS profit_factor,
  MAX(pt.exit_time) AS latest_exit
FROM paper_trades pt
JOIN signal_ctx sc ON sc.signal_id = pt.signal_id
WHERE pt.status = 'CLOSED'
  AND pt.followed_rules = TRUE
  AND pt.pnl IS NOT NULL
  AND sc.contract_price >= 0.75
  AND sc.contract_price < 0.80
  AND sc.spread <= 0.03
  AND sc.time_remaining_seconds >= 240
  AND sc.time_remaining_seconds < 300
  AND sc.momentum_score <= -3
GROUP BY target_vs_5h_high
ORDER BY target_vs_5h_high;

hypotheses.name: Premium 0.80-0.85 near expiry
hypotheses.description: Premium BTC 15-minute contracts in the 0.80-0.85 band with 4-5 minutes remaining and meaningful distance from target may offer the best tradeoff between win probability and entry cost. This frozen slice tracks the stricter NO-side subset with spread <= 0.03 and momentum <= -3.
hypotheses.sql:
SELECT
  s.side,
  COUNT(*) AS trades,
  ROUND(AVG(pt.pnl > 0) * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(pt.pnl), 4) AS total_pnl,
  ROUND(AVG(pt.pnl), 4) AS avg_pnl,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pt.pnl > 0 THEN pt.pnl END), 4) AS avg_win,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN pt.pnl < 0 THEN pt.pnl END), 4) AS avg_loss,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN pt.pnl > 0 THEN pt.pnl ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pt.pnl < 0 THEN pt.pnl ELSE 0 END)), 0),
    2
  ) AS profit_factor,
  ROUND(AVG(s.contract_price), 4) AS avg_entry_price,
  ROUND(AVG(s.spread), 4) AS avg_spread,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(s.btc_price - s.target_price)), 2) AS avg_abs_gap,
  MAX(pt.exit_time) AS latest_exit
FROM paper_trades pt
JOIN signals s ON s.id = pt.signal_id
WHERE pt.status = 'CLOSED'
  AND pt.followed_rules = TRUE
  AND pt.pnl IS NOT NULL
  AND s.side = 'NO'
  AND s.contract_price >= 0.80
  AND s.contract_price < 0.85
  AND s.time_remaining_seconds BETWEEN 240 AND 300
  AND ABS(s.btc_price - s.target_price) >= 50
  AND s.spread <= 0.03
  AND s.momentum_score <= -3
GROUP BY s.side;

hypotheses.name: Late dominant NO 0.90-0.96 09:30-11:00
hypotheses.description: Bookmark for the narrow late-dominant-compression pocket: buy the dominant NO contract only when ask is 0.90-0.96, 240-300 seconds remain, BTC is at least $120 below strike, spread is <= 1c, and signal time is 09:30-11:00 ET. Initial diagnostic sample was only 5 unique markets, so this is a watch-only hypothesis, not a live strategy.
hypotheses.sql:
WITH quote_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    ms.id AS snapshot_id,
    ms.captured_at AS observed_at,
    m.id AS market_pk,
    m.market_id AS market_ticker,
    m.target_price AS strike,
    ms.btc_price,
    ms.time_remaining_seconds AS tte_seconds,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='NO' THEN c.id END) AS no_contract_pk,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='NO' THEN cs.bid_price END) AS no_bid,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='NO' THEN cs.ask_price END) AS no_ask,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='NO' THEN COALESCE(cs.spread, cs.ask_price - cs.bid_price) END) AS no_spread,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='YES' THEN cs.bid_price END) AS yes_bid,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.side='YES' THEN cs.ask_price END) AS yes_ask
  FROM market_snapshots ms
  JOIN markets m ON m.id = ms.market_id
  JOIN contract_snapshots cs ON cs.market_snapshot_id = ms.id
  JOIN contracts c ON c.id = cs.contract_id
  GROUP BY ms.id, ms.captured_at, m.id, m.market_id, m.target_price, ms.btc_price, ms.time_remaining_seconds
), candidates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      q.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.market_ticker ORDER BY q.observed_at ASC) AS rn
    FROM quote_pivot q
    WHERE q.no_bid > q.yes_bid
      AND q.no_ask > q.yes_ask
      AND ((q.no_bid + q.no_ask) / 2) > ((q.yes_bid + q.yes_ask) / 2)
      AND q.no_ask >= 0.90
      AND q.no_ask < 0.96
      AND q.tte_seconds BETWEEN 240 AND 300
      AND q.no_spread <= 0.01
      AND q.btc_price < q.strike
      AND q.strike - q.btc_price >= 120
      AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(q.observed_at, '+00:00', '-04:00')) >= '09:30:00'
      AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(q.observed_at, '+00:00', '-04:00')) < '11:00:00'
  ) x
  WHERE rn = 1
), replay AS (
  SELECT
    c.snapshot_id,
    c.market_ticker,
    DATE(c.observed_at) AS active_day,
    c.no_ask AS entry_ask,
    MIN(CASE WHEN fcs.bid_price >= c.no_ask + 0.01 THEN fms.captured_at END) AS target_1c_hit_at,
    MIN(CASE WHEN fcs.bid_price >= c.no_ask + 0.02 THEN fms.captured_at END) AS target_2c_hit_at,
    MIN(CASE WHEN fcs.bid_price >= c.no_ask + 0.03 THEN fms.captured_at END) AS target_3c_hit_at,
    MIN(CASE WHEN fcs.bid_price <= c.no_ask - 0.02 THEN fms.captured_at END) AS stop_2c_hit_at,
    MIN(CASE WHEN fcs.bid_price <= c.no_ask - 0.03 THEN fms.captured_at END) AS stop_3c_hit_at,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(fcs.bid_price ORDER BY fms.captured_at DESC), ',', 1) AS final_bid
  FROM candidates c
  LEFT JOIN market_snapshots fms
    ON fms.market_id = c.market_pk
   AND fms.captured_at > c.observed_at
   AND fms.captured_at <= c.observed_at + INTERVAL 120 SECOND
  LEFT JOIN contract_snapshots fcs
    ON fcs.market_snapshot_id = fms.id
   AND fcs.contract_id = c.no_contract_pk
  GROUP BY c.snapshot_id, c.market_ticker, DATE(c.observed_at), c.no_ask
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN target_1c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (stop_2c_hit_at IS NULL OR target_1c_hit_at < stop_2c_hit_at) THEN 1.0
      WHEN stop_2c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (target_1c_hit_at IS NULL OR stop_2c_hit_at < target_1c_hit_at) THEN -2.0
      ELSE ROUND((CAST(final_bid AS DECIMAL(10,4)) - entry_ask) * 100, 4)
    END AS pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop,
    CASE
      WHEN target_2c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (stop_2c_hit_at IS NULL OR target_2c_hit_at < stop_2c_hit_at) THEN 2.0
      WHEN stop_2c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (target_2c_hit_at IS NULL OR stop_2c_hit_at < target_2c_hit_at) THEN -2.0
      ELSE ROUND((CAST(final_bid AS DECIMAL(10,4)) - entry_ask) * 100, 4)
    END AS pnl_2c_vs_2c_stop,
    CASE
      WHEN target_3c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (stop_3c_hit_at IS NULL OR target_3c_hit_at < stop_3c_hit_at) THEN 3.0
      WHEN stop_3c_hit_at IS NOT NULL AND (target_3c_hit_at IS NULL OR stop_3c_hit_at < target_3c_hit_at) THEN -3.0
      ELSE ROUND((CAST(final_bid AS DECIMAL(10,4)) - entry_ask) * 100, 4)
    END AS pnl_3c_vs_3c_stop
  FROM replay
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS unique_markets,
  COUNT(DISTINCT active_day) AS active_days,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_1c_vs_2c_stop,
  ROUND(AVG(pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop), 4) AS avg_gross_pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop,
  ROUND(AVG(pnl_2c_vs_2c_stop), 4) AS avg_gross_pnl_2c_vs_2c_stop,
  ROUND(AVG(pnl_3c_vs_3c_stop), 4) AS avg_gross_pnl_3c_vs_3c_stop,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop > 0 THEN pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop < 0 THEN pnl_1c_vs_2c_stop ELSE 0 END)), 0), 4) AS profit_factor_1c_vs_2c_stop,
  MAX(active_day) AS latest_day
FROM scored;
